mapper.insert: insert into tlias.clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, update_time, create_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, #{updateTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time from tlias.clazz c where id = #{id}
